dedupe_keys.name: wastewater volumes processed by municipal sewage systems

description: Statistics Canada table 38-10-0099-01 reports monthly municipal wastewater volumes by province, territory and drainage region. The table is available as an HTML view and CSV export for national wastewater-flow comparisons. This resource is provided by Government of Canada, Statistics Canada. Coverage is national as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists CSV, HTML formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence terms are linked in the provider metadata and require reading before reuse. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Aggregate volumes cannot specify individual sewer-network topology or process parameters. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
